messages:
maya: Town Square tomorrow 11:00 PT — brief format (25m). Please add questions to the Q&A doc or drop them below. Well surface the top upvoted ones in the AMA.

maya: Agenda (25m):
- 11:00-11:05 Exec pulse  priorities + hiring ask
- 11:05-11:12 Product highlight  cost-control tooling + routing demo
- 11:12-11:18 Policy & ops  telemetry anonymization default + runbook circuit-breaker
- 11:18-11:25 Live Q&A (pick top upvoted)

maya: Q&A doc: https://docs.google.com/redwood-town-square-qna (add + upvote)

dmitri: Product: demoing a new cost-control dashboard and per-route budget alerts. Early internal tests show ~10% unit cost reduction on inference-heavy workloads. Slides will show a small config snippet.

sara: Ops/policy: new default for telemetry is "anonymized" for new projects (no full debug indices stored) with a 75-day retention for anonymized traces. Teams can opt in to full debug indices per-project if needed. Migration/export guide in the Q&A doc.

kevin: Runbook change: added a circuit-breaker that pauses retries for 30s after three consecutive target-zone failures; during that window we notify oncall+product lead. I pasted the short runbook diff into the doc.

sara: Export example I added to the doc: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports -d '{"project":"example","range":"75d","anonymize":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'```

olivia: Managers: headcount asks go into the hiring tracker by EOD. Well call out approved asks at the end. Also note: EMEA office hour tomorrow 17:00 CET for follow-ups.

all-hands-bot: Reminder posted: Town Square  Product + Policy update  Tomorrow 11:00 PT (link in #general).

recording-bot: Recording uploaded after the meeting: https://records.redwood.co/meetings/1905123456-town-square.mp4 (slides: https://slides.redwood.co/allhands/1905123456)

maya: Post-meeting takeaways (short):
- Exec: continued focus on platform reliability + cost predictability; hiring ask approved for +3 infra/SRE and +2 customer success roles.
- Product: cost-control dashboard demoed; per-route budgets cut token spend on test jobs by ~10% with no perf regression.
- Policy: default telemetry anonymization for new projects, 75-day anonymized retention; opt-in to full debug retained data documented.
- Ops: circuit-breaker retry pause implemented; notification goes to oncall+product lead; weekly runbook validation scheduled.

maya: If your Q in the doc wasnt answered live well reply in-thread and update the notes. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
